svg.title: Certifications
svg.desc: Earned: Cisco CCNA 200-301 on 19 March 2026. Preparing: AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate, November 2026. Planned: Certified Kubernetes Administrator. North star: Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist.
